scope: Independent board DDR diagnostic; no CNN/video DDR client or production changes
clock: Original DDR IP dhi_clk, approximately 133.33 MHz; no crossing in request/compare path
reset: Asynchronous assertion, synchronized top-level release; board reset restarts the entire original DDR IP, not only the requester
traffic: Two rounds; four raw PAXI addresses 0/8/16/24; write all, then read reverse order; at most one address/data pair or read in flight
data: 128-bit little-endian distinct per-byte patterns, second round complemented
write_mask: 16'h0000; IPUG035 1.4 printed page30 defines PAXI high-active masking, unlike AXI WSTRB. Consistent with existing PH1P source; board readback still pending
address_units: IPUG035 table3-5: current 16-bit DDR maps byte_address=PAXI_address*2; native stride8 spans16bytes. Actual 52-64MiB reservation and full capacity remain untested
handshake: Offer AW/W together, retire each only on its own ready; payload stable while stalled; AR/R counted separately; require one-beat RLAST
write_visibility: The first diagnostic reads after both AW/W were accepted, without invented delay or B response. Successful comparisons are observations for this sequence, not a general write barrier or tensor READY contract.
failure: Latched first address, expected 128-bit word, actual 128-bit word and error class; no retry or automatic change of mask/address convention
board: HX1P35A, PH1P35MDG324 speed 3, KEY4/C7; reuse existing HDMI TEST display; JTAG SRAM only after validation
full_chip_simulation: Still unavailable without supported DDR2 device model; controlled endpoint tests must be labeled protocol-only
